blocks.text: Search and discovery API that powers instant, relevant results

Algolia provides hosted search infrastructure that delivers relevant results in under 50 milliseconds. Instead of building and maintaining your own search engine with Elasticsearch or similar, you index your data with Algolia and get a fully-featured search API immediately.

The relevance quality is what separates Algolia from DIY search solutions. Typo tolerance, synonym handling, faceted filtering, and AI-powered ranking produce results that users expect from Google-quality search. Building this level of relevance from scratch would require dedicated search engineering expertise.

For e-commerce, documentation, and marketplace applications, Algolia's impact on user experience is measurable. Faster search, better relevance, and instant results directly correlate with higher engagement and conversion rates.
Finds results even when users make spelling mistakes
Dynamic filters that refine results by attributes
Machine learning-powered relevance that improves over time
Search analytics showing what users look for and find
Pre-built React, Vue, and Angular search components
Building good search is harder than it looks. Algolia delivers search quality that would take months to build in-house, with sub-50ms response times that make the experience feel instant.
Our engineers work with Algolia daily and can help you integrate it into your stack.
